sources.citation: Wright et al. (2019), The Gaia-ESO Survey: Asymmetric expansion of the Lagoon Nebula cluster NGC 6530 from GES and Gaia DR2
Pinned common ICRS image-frame origin derived from registered observations; adopted display centre, not a measured nebular centroid.

introduction.text: The Lagoon is a star-forming H II region about 1,326 parsecs away. Its young NGC 6530 cluster shares the surrounding cloud complex.

distance.method: Adopted Gaia DR2 cluster distance from Wright et al. (2019), section 3.4: 1326 −69/+77 pc, including the stated parallax zero-point correction and systematic uncertainty. It is not an individual gas-cloud depth measurement.

classification.name: H II region and star-forming nebula
classification.basis: Observed optical and infrared emission on an authored coherent front with local literature-guided structure. Foreground extinction, distinct molecular clouds and true front/back distances are not reconstructed.
